name: conflicting_source_claims
description: Two credible fixed sources describe the same event but disagree on a factual detail.

candidates.title: Metro power fault temporarily closes the airport branch
candidates.search_snippet: A power fault closed the airport branch for 42 minutes.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic operator notice. A traction-power fault closed the airport branch for 42 minutes. The notice identifies the affected section, the protection action, and the restoration process.

candidates.title: Airport branch power incident resolved after a longer interruption
candidates.search_snippet: The same airport branch power incident lasted 47 minutes.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic government notice. The same traction-power fault affected the airport branch and service resumed after 47 minutes. The notice identifies the same section and restoration event but gives a different duration.

authoritative_factual_claims: The same traction-power event affected the airport branch and service was restored.
The exact service duration is not asserted.

contract_notes: Event Identity may establish one event while a factual claim remains unresolved.
Both source-specific claims and provenance must be retained.
MaiAgent must omit the unresolved duration rather than choose a value.
